generation.explanation: A Galton board turns repeated left-or-right choices into a distribution: after 8 rows, a ball lands in bin k if it went right exactly k times. If each bounce independently goes right with probability p, then P(K = k) = C(8, k)p^k(1 − p)^(8 − k). Watch the blue experimental bars approach the gold theoretical marks as more balls fall; drag the bias handle to see how changing p shifts the distribution.
